method.declared: 2026-11-14T03:33+04:00, before any change map was computed (first run 03:39)
method.inputs: NISAR L2 GCOV, track 056, ascending, frame 014, mode 4005 (10 m), finished files only
method.valid_pixel: mask is a subswath number (1-254), HH > 0 and HV > 0
method.speckle_filter: 3x3 block mean in linear power (multilook) -> 30 m pixels; a block is valid only if all 9 pixels are valid
method.side_value: per-pixel median in dB of all passes inside the window (N < 3 per side = 'median not robust': one bad date can't be outvoted)
method.interference_check: sample the whole frame on a 40x40 grid of 32x32-pixel windows; compare each pass with the first before-pass; anomaly over the box if |box median change - frame median change| >= 1.5 dB in HH or HV
method.channel_for_rules: HH only (HV is shown but not used, because the regional anomaly is strongest in HV)
method.local_normalisation: each side's background = median dB of 2 km x 2 km tiles (66 x 66 pixels), bilinear between tile centres; delta = (after - background_after) - (before - background_before). Removes smooth regional offsets (processing version, interference); can only hide changes wider than ~2 km, never invent them
method.gain_check: in every tile, delta of the darkest quarter minus delta of the brightest quarter of unchanged pixels; if the median over tiles is beyond +/-2 dB the brightness difference is not a simple gain -> radar quality check fails

sea_window.chosen_from: NASA HLS photo of 18 Jun 2026 (open sea, away from the Palm)

land_window.chosen_from: NASA HLS photo of 18 Jun 2026 (open desert sand)

method.water_level: T_water = 90th percentile of the sea window (before image)
method.land_level: T_land = 10th percentile of the desert window (before image)
method.separable: water and land can be told apart only if T_water < T_land; otherwise water<->land classes are 'not separable' (trap 11) and not reported
method.X_reason: 3 dB is about 3 sigma of speckle noise on a difference of two 30 m pixels (~42 looks each), and new walls, roofs and fill typically raise L-band HH by 3-10 dB

classes.water-to-land: before <= T_water and after (brightness-matched) >= T_land and delta >= +X
classes.land-to-water: before >= T_land and after <= T_water and delta <= -X
classes.new-structures: delta >= +X and after >= T_land (and not water-to-land)

method.hotspots: 8-connected clusters of one class, at least 12 pixels (1.08 ha); top 10 by area
method.photo_dates: clearest NASA HLS (S30 or L30) day within +/-10 days of the first before pass and the last after pass; score = valid share x (1 - white-cloud share); ties (within 0.02) -> nearest date
method.badge_rule: Strong if >= 7 of 10 hotspots are photo-confirmed; Moderate if radar only (photo check not done) or 4-6 confirmed; Weak otherwise. 'Radar only' counts as Moderate only if the radar quality checks pass and at least one hotspot exists; otherwise Weak.
method.coherence_check: UAE interferograms on hand are track 128 frame 015, which start ~25.2 N, north of this box (top edge 25.06 N): no coherence check for Jebel Ali
